title: Stoppage-time penalty against de Ligt, given after VAR review
summary: At 1-1, David Coote waved away West Ham's appeal after Matthijs de Ligt challenged Danny Ings. VAR Michael Oliver judged there was enough contact and sent Coote to the monitor. Coote gave the penalty and Jarrod Bowen scored the winner. The KMI panel later said the intervention was wrong. Erik ten Hag was sacked the next day.
onField: No penalty, overturned after monitor review
consequences: Manchester United sacked Erik ten Hag the following day.

reactions.quote: The VAR deemed there was sufficient contact on Ings' lower leg and recommended an on-field review. The referee overturned his original decision and awarded a penalty.
